$comment: THE SMART REGISTRATIONS THIS DEPLOYMENT PRESENTS. Replace this file when you
deploy SPiER yourself — the values below are SPiER's own and are not yours.
A SMART app does not have *a* client_id. It is registered separately with
every EHR it launches from, and each registration mints its own; that is what
registration IS. So this is a map from the ISSUER's origin to the client_id
A client_id is NOT a secret — it travels in the /authorize query string in the
clear, and SPiER is a public client using PKCE. This file is data rather than
a credential store, and it is checked in on purpose: see
web/src/lib/smartClients.ts for why it must not be an environment variable.
One place, and the tooling reads it: scripts/medplum-register-launch.mjs
parses THIS file rather than restating a UUID, so a registration it writes and
the client_id the app presents cannot disagree.
